chapter.heading: If People Can’t See What God Is Doing
chapter.v:
Anyone who
goes on stubbornly rejecting many warnings will be suddenly destroyed, without hope of healing.

When good
people are in charge, everybody celebrates; but when the wicked rule, everybody groans.

A man
who loves wisdom makes his father happy, but one who visits prostitutes throws away his money.

A king
who rules justly makes the country secure, but one who asks for bribes will destroy it.

Those who
flatter their friends lay a net to trip them up.

Evil people
are trapped by their own sins, but those who do right sing and celebrate.

Good people
care about treating the poor fairly, but the wicked don't think about it at all.

Cynical people
can inflame a whole city, but the wise calm angry people down.

When a
wise man takes a stupid man to court, there's raging and ridicule, but nothing is settled.

Murderers hate
people of integrity, but those who live right try to help them.

Stupid people
let all their anger out, while wise people quietly hold it in.

A ruler
who listens to lies will have nothing but wicked officials.

Poor people
and their oppressors have this in common: the Lord gives life to all of them.

If a
king judges the poor fairly, he will have a long rule.

Discipline and
correction provide wisdom, but a son left undisciplined is an embarrassment to his mother.

When the
wicked are in power, sin increases; but the good will see their downfall.

Discipline your
children and they won't give you any worries; they will make you very happy.

Without a
revelation from God, the people go out of control, but those who keep the law are happy.

A servant
can't be disciplined by words alone; though they understand, they don't follow what they're told.

Have you
seen a man who speaks without thinking? There's more hope for stupid people than for him!

A servant
indulged from childhood will in the end become unmanageable.

Angry people
stir up trouble, those with short tempers commit many sins.

If you're
proud, you'll be humiliated; but if you're humble, you'll be honored.

A thief's
partner hates his life; even under the threat of being cursed he can't tell the truth.

Being afraid
of people traps you, but if you trust in the Lord you're safe.

Many people
look for favors from a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.

Good people
hate those who are unjust; the wicked hate those who do what's right.
